endpoints.healthy_specificity_denominator: known-onset lifecycles plus verified healthy controls
endpoints.strict_machine_success: known fault: no held-out-healthy alarm and persistent unhealthy alarm; healthy control: no held-out-healthy alarm
endpoints.unknown_onset_handling: predicted and reported but excluded from scored denominator
endpoints.conservative_full_70_rate: scored successes divided by all 70, treating five unscored lifecycles as non-successes

communication_screen.execution_interpretation: 70 logical clients multiplexed sequentially; not 70 simultaneous physical radios

claim_boundary: This trial demonstrates a 70-logical-client federated execution over already opened machine lifecycles.
It is not independent validation and does not represent 70 physical LilyGO boards.
Five onset-unavailable run-to-failure devices cannot enter a scored accuracy denominator.
The result is fixed after this first complete execution; no threshold or partition tuning is permitted from its outcomes.
